brief: Return a sorted copy of a single-type array
description: Return a new array with the same entries as array, ordered using compareFunction. Entries that compare equal keep their order (a stable sort). The array may hold any mix of data types, as compareFunction decides the order; the result has the array's data type, if it has one. compareFunction is called with two entries and must return true when the first should sort before the second (boolean), not a numeric sort key.

parameters.description: Return true if value1 should be ordered before value2.
parameters.name: compareFunction

parameters.description: Array to sort. Must be single-type (all entries the same data type).
parameters.name: array

returns.description: A new array with the entries of array in sorted order.
